name: watershed
description: Node dependencies for watershed's live JavaScript integration suite (test/live_js.gleam) and its p2p reference services (tools/signaling and tools/relay). The library itself has no npm dependencies; `phoenix` is an optional peer dep of the real transport, `nostr-tools` is an optional peer dep of the serverless nostr signaling adapter, and `ws` supplies the WebSocket global Node lacks as well as the signaling service's server.
